opening.argument: The speaker leads with a claimed daily income of one lakh rupees, then directly invites viewers seeking online earnings to respond. Interested viewers are told to “ask for the link of a plan meeting attend a one meeting” and are told they “can become one of our members.” Forsage and Eagle Team branding appears alongside a large WhatsApp contact number, reinforcing that direct invitation to join. Taken together, the income claim, meeting and link, and membership invitation present an online earning plan through recruitment, not reporting or analysis.
